<DOCSTRING>
Stores user information and provides methods to check if the user is an adult.

Description:
Created by the UserRegistration service, used by the AccessControl module to validate user access based on age.

Attributes:
    name (str): The user's name. Set during initialization and not modified thereafter.
    age (int): The user's age. Set during initialization and not modified thereafter.
</DOCSTRING>
